latestSnapshot.readme: This dataset contains the raw MRI data used to build and validate the mouse lemur template and atlas (available through https://www.nitrc.org/projects/mouselemuratlas).It includes T2-weighted fast spin echo scans recorded from 34 animals.Details of this dataset can be found in Nadkarni, N. A., Bougacha, S., Garin, C., Dhenain, M., & Picq, J. L. (2019). A 3D population-based brain atlas of the mouse lemur primate with examples of applications in aging studies and comparative anatomy. Neuroimage, 185, 85-95. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2018.10.010
